notes.title: Developer update: Patch notes 10/11/2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/9bc3faf03ef983dde0b880a79add5958374e14cb.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback of Tears of Avia. We have been working hard and are happy to introduce new bug fixes and balance changes to the world of Estera. Please see the full list below:

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
- Can no longer move onto the same tile as another player that is also in progress of moving to 
- Deft strike, swap and teleport now allow moves to undo correctly to the tile you teleported to rather than the tile you started the turn at 
- Buffs should no longer 'miss' targets with high def
- game hanging when triggering achievements 
- damage numbers displaying twice
- Desert 2 damage challenge now works as advertised 
- Clicking the base panel while a skill is being targeted no longer leaves the target indicator visible 
- Fixed an issue where sometimes graphics settings would not save 
- Formatting issue on the deploy screen that caused Prisoner 1337's name to overlap 
- fixes triggering of the legion/long shot achievements 
- summon spiders no longer bug out when skipped
- Source of sorrow challenges now work as intended - Frozen city 2 had some active tiles floating in empty space 
- Icy wastes 2 challenges now work as intended
- Orphanage challenges work as intended
- Achievement for completing all the challenges should now trigger correctly
- You no longer take reflected damage when you own a reflect totem and heal an ally
- Damage numbers appear when the attack strikes, rather than when the attack ends for: zombie punches, slash, fireball, firebolt and energy bolt
- fixes fire and lightning shields such that they are despawned if the wielder is defeated
- you can now assign space bar as a bindable key
- pipework dusters no longer display the wrong model
- Nosaram now performs his split phase when you reload a hardcore save at the split phase point
- When you spend ID scrolls, the ID scroll counts are updated in the inventory/shop screens
- Swap skill no longer fails when skipping the animation
- Collateral damage should now do 25% of the damage as specified rather than 100%

[h3][b]Balance/Game Changes[/b][/h3]
- Nerfed priest XP gain
- Right clicking and dragging off of keybinds no longer leaves all buttons in a highlighted state 
- Made adjustments to the way loot is generated to promote more potential desired stat drops
- Clicking on the back tooltip while assigning new keys now closes keybind assign mode 
- If you use teleport on a mage portal, you will now also travel down the portal after teleporting 
- If you summon a creature onto a mage portal, that creature will be teleported down the portal 
- Summons can now undo moves after their first turn deployed 
- Rebalances catacomb and swamp levels in standard mode
- You can no longer 'end turn' when the 'stage clear' banner appears using a joypad
- Improves the shrine screen UI



We are constantly listening to your feedback and looking at ways to improve the game. 

Thank you for your support! 

- CooCooSqueaky & PQube 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/6e7278a8546d166324bc0fbfafd9584ecb6efe9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer update: Patch notes 20/10/2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34604608/79847f99e972060cb55f8d8134f70a97f2cb6a35.png[/img]


Hey everyone,

Firstly, thank you all very much for supporting Tears of Avia! It has been a passion project fuelled over the past few years. Now the game is out and in your hands, we wanted to provide a steady stream of updates through regular patch notes! Please see below for our first batch of bug fixes and balance changes. 

[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]
- Item dupe glitch
- Bug that prevented progress in the apex of eternity if Afren has local passive buffs
- Fixes a bug in Mechanophage where all the party members would appear ontop of each other
- Fixes a crash in the mine boss
- Fixes a bug in the final boss if you re-try it for a second time
- Adjustments to the way sounds are played to avoid in-game SFX cutting out
- Fixes an issue where cameras would be stuck on the ground if you died while taking reflected damage
- Fixes summoning level 5 animal summons failing to show up
- Fixes skipping summoning bear not actually summoning the bear
- Partially fixes keybindings in battle maps
- Using deft strike near a level border edge locks gameplay
- You can now talk to the prisoner in the desert tavern
- You can no longer displace immovable giant bosses with shockwave
- The meteor strike sound playing even if you target no enemies



[h3][b]Balance/game changes [/b][/h3]
- Nerfed reflect to cap damage to no more than 50% of the player's maximum life
- Totem information is now displayed on the map confirm screen
- If you take reflected damage the damage number is shown on you with the word reflected to indicate as such
- Increased the variety of items on the Tirig blacksmith
- Adds levels to the players/enemies on the Tirig arena screen
- Changes the description of upgrade shards to properly reflect the tier skills would get upgraded to
- Allows you to proceed in the Tirig arena using a joypad
- Slight nerf to blackwater bay 2 bandits
- You can now skip enemy movement (if there are no traps in their path)
- Better loot drops in all grasslands levels prior to the bay levels
- Expanded the camera border in a couple of levels


We are constantly listening to your feedback and looking at ways to improve the game. 

Thank you for your support! 

- CooCooSqueaky & PQube

notes.title: A Steam page update!
notes.content:
Hey Steam Community! 

A little update from us here at CooCooSqueaky, we’ve done a real big refresh of the Steam page ːsteamhappyː

We’re sorry we’ve been quiet recently, we’re all heads down working on the game as we want to make it the best it can be for when release date comes around (we’ll talk about announcing that another time), so today we’re revealing a new shiny Steam page! 

We’d love to get your thoughts on it, so drop a comment below or search us on your favourite social channels and let us know there. 

And if you’re new here, we’d love it if you could put us in your Wishlist! 

Thanks, 
Team CooCooSqueaky
